import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
lum = im.mean(2)
sat = im.max(2)-im.min(2)
# contrast enhance around table band: subtract row median
sub = lum.copy()
for y in range(144):
    sub[y] -= np.median(lum[y])
for y in range(50,100):
    line=''
    for x in range(0,256,2):
        v = sub[y,x:x+2].mean()
        if sat[y,x]>25: line+='#'
        elif v>6: line+='+'
        elif v<-6: line+='-'
        elif v>2: line+='.'
        elif v<-2: line+=','
        else: line+=' '
    print(f'{y:3d} '+line)
\"
